cards.card_text: The king has no deputy to hear him The king's judges have been bribed The king is busy fighting a war
cards.verse_text: Absalom would say, “Look, your claims are good and right, but the king has no deputy to hear you.”
cards.snippet: …“Look, your claims are good and right, but the king has no deputy to hear you.”

cards.card_text: Over in Edom, there's no king, just a deputy serving as king.
cards.verse_text: And there was no king in Edom; a deputy served as king.
cards.snippet: And there was no king in Edom; a deputy served as king.
